name: Preferra Insurance
one_liner: Professional liability insurance built by social workers, for social workers - the official NASW-endorsed carrier.
short_description: Preferra Insurance (formerly NASW Assurance Services) is a Risk Retention Group owned by social workers, offering professional liability insurance specifically designed for clinical social workers ...
long_description: Preferra Insurance Company RRG (formerly NASW Assurance Services / American Professional Agency) is the only professional liability insurance carrier owned by social workers for social workers. As a Risk Retention Group, Preferra is owned by its policyholders and endorsed by the National Association of Social Workers (NASW). They offer professional liability coverage specifically tailored to the unique risks social workers face, including coverage for licensed clinical social workers (LCSWs), MSWs, BSWs, and social work students. Preferra policies include coverage for professional services, license defense, cyber liability, and personal injury. They offer occurrence-based policies with limits up to $2M/$4M. NASW members receive discounted rates. Preferra is known for their understanding of social work practice and their social worker-specific risk management resources, including ethics consultations and CE courses focused on social work liability issues.
best_for: MSWs and BSWs in clinical practice
not_for: LMFTs, LPCs, or psychologists (not core focus)
Large agencies needing complex entity coverage
Those outside the social work profession

pricing.notes: NASW members receive discounted rates. Premiums vary by license type, coverage limits, hours worked, and state. Online quotes available.

compliance.notes: Risk Retention Group owned by social workers. Endorsed by NASW. State regulated as RRG.

seo.meta_description: Preferra Insurance (formerly NASW Assurance) - professional liability insurance for social workers. NASW-endorsed. LCSW coverage starting ~$155/year.

faqs.a: Preferra Insurance Company RRG (formerly NASW Assurance Services) is a Risk Retention Group owned by social workers, providing professional liability insurance specifically for the social work profession.

faqs.q: Do NASW members get a discount?
faqs.a: Yes, NASW members receive discounted rates on Preferra professional liability policies. The discount varies but typically saves members 10-15%.

faqs.q: Does Preferra only cover social workers?
faqs.a: Preferra's primary focus is social workers (LCSWs, MSWs, BSWs). While they may offer coverage to some related professions, their policies are specifically designed for social work practice.
A Risk Retention Group (RRG) is a liability insurance company owned by its policyholders. Preferra is owned by social workers, meaning policyholders have a stake in the company.

company_info.notes: Preferra is endorsed by the National Association of Social Workers (NASW) and is the only malpractice insurer owned by social workers for social workers.
